description:
Story 3 of fz-kdt.13 Strategy v3 (cold-reviewed). Blocked by fz-kdt.13.1.

One derivation per CallSiteKey owning that callsite's CallSiteSummary/
CallSiteTargets/Activation/ActivationInputs; one whole-body derivation owning
ReturnType/ActivationAnalyzed and reading everything (absorbs define_return's
hidden ascents state). A callsite derivation's read set = the prefix of the
existing dataflow-ordered reads vector (semantic.rs:106, threaded through the
walk) captured at emission time, PLUS all post-coalescing reads
(rebuild_coalesced_call_emission and contract reads fold into the affected
sets), PLUS completion-time reads (normalize_contributions reads body_keying/
dispatch_masks -- attribute to every derivation or whole-body). Shift causes
dirty all derivations. Blocked runs mark only unreached derivations dirty.

Soundness property test: recomputing a callsite derivation with its recorded
read set held fixed reproduces its outputs (catches a too-early watermark).

## Checks
- Facts settle mid-drive: ActivationInputs/Activation/callsite facts reach
  settled before the drain rather than at it (count from work_graph.quiesced
  by kind).
- AnalyzeActivation evals ratchet on the three fixtures (post-kdt.63 bases:
  1,081 CLI-lens on take_drop_split); backend inventory pins (59/221/214)
  hold or drop.
- Zero-uncaused unweakened; determinism suite green; matrix green.
- Re-measure the pop-time ready-alternative rate afterward (Story 4's gate).
title: analyze_activation reports derivations by read watermark
